notes.title: Full release!
notes.notes:
After 7 years of development I can now finally consider Powerlust to be a finished game!

The main goal was to finish the story mode, which is now done.

Does that mean there will be no more updates?
No, of course not.

I have a ton of other stuff I want to add.
My main focus will be adding more variety to the items and adding more endgame stuff.

I think legendary items with unique abilities and being able to combine multiple of them into one through crafting is what makes the game fun, so I want to add even more OP combinations in the future :]
